data.title: 玛露希尔 · 学院古籍的书签
data.description: 【精灵学院图书馆·午后】玛露希尔穿着蓝色学院夹克坐在高窗边，为一本古籍制作叶脉书签；她把完成的书签夹进书页，抬头时尖耳和绿瞳都因为找到合适的魔法材料而闪亮。
data.action: 高窗边为古籍制作叶脉书签，材料干透后尖耳和绿瞳一起亮起来
data.lighting: dusty afternoon light through the high window
data.mood: 把魔法研究变成书页间的心动
data.promptProse: At the elven academy library's high window, Marcille Donato presses a leaf-vein bookmark into an ancient book, checking the dried material before looking up with delighted green eyes and lifted pointed ears. Her blue academic jacket, white blouse and long skirt stay orderly. The vertical medium portrait includes the desk and tall shelves behind. Afternoon light reveals drifting dust, translucent leaf veins and paper grain, with a narrow bookmark shadow marking the open page.
